focal_point: A proof grid: several small panels rather than one hero. Appropriate for a back, soft as a standalone.
eye_path: F across panels: a heading, then a scan of benefits or steps.
scale_ratios: Headings repeat at one size. No numeral hero. Fine for proof, flat if this were the front.
type_choices: Consistent family, small body, headings one step up.
photo_art_direction: Supporting pictures, smaller than the front portrait, same calm grade.
offer_placement: The back does not introduce a new deal. It explains. That role split is the lesson.
trust_and_cta: Marks repeat. Legal-scale lines are present. Do not copy the carrier system.

focal.reason: Panels are even, which a back can survive.

hierarchy.reason: Flat by front standards, ordered as proof.

grid.reason: The grid is the point of this face.

eye_path.reason: F-pattern matches a list of proof.

gestalt.reason: Repeated panels read as one system.

color.reason: Same restrained palette as the front.

photo.reason: Pictures support; they do not argue.

offer.reason: No second offer, which is correct.

cta.reason: Response repeats without a new campaign.

trust.reason: Brand trust, not a badge wall we can reuse.

glance_3s.reason: A glance does not need to; this is the flip side.

emulate: A proof back in the same palette and grid as the front, with no new offer.
do_not_copy: Every mark, layout detail, and line of this carrier piece.
anti_patterns: Using a proof grid as a front.
summary: The back of the same style-reference piece. It shows the proof role. It is not a front to imitate.
